title: Balcones Canyonland Conservation Focus
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened as a worksession focused solely on the Balcones Canyonland Conservation Plan.
*   Discussions included a detailed presentation on the plan, specifically highlighting 14 species of concern within the Balcones Canyonland area.
*   City environmental staff addressed the City of Austin's involvement and strategy regarding the critical conservation efforts.
